home.newProjectHint: Start writing in seconds. No account needed.
home.browserNotice: Browser preview: projects are stored in this browser only.

errors.notAProject: That folder isn't a Sheaf project.
errors.newerFormat: This project was made with a newer version of Sheaf. Update Sheaf to open it.

project.noDocument: Select a document in the binder, or create one.
project.conflictBanner_one: Found {{count}} sync-conflict copy. Nothing was overwritten.
project.conflictBanner_other: Found {{count}} sync-conflict copies. Nothing was overwritten.
project.conflictsFound_one: Found {{count}} sync-conflict copy. See the note at the top.
project.conflictsFound_other: Found {{count}} sync-conflict copies. See the note at the top.
project.treeProblems: Some documents had a missing or looping parent and are shown under Manuscript.

save.conflict: “{{title}}” was changed somewhere else. Your version was kept as “{{copy}}”.

targets.title: Writing targets
targets.countUnitHint: Chinese, Japanese and Korean text is counted by character; everything else by word.
targets.deadlineHint: Set a target and a date to see a daily pace.
targets.sessionHint: Counted from the moment you opened this project.

history.title: History of “{{title}}”
history.empty: No snapshots yet. Sheaf keeps one automatically before replacing text it hasn't kept recently.
history.pick: Choose a version to compare with the current text.
history.restored: Restored the version from {{when}}. The text you had was kept as a snapshot first.

language.title: Language and checking
language.projectLanguageHint: Used for paragraphs too short to judge. Sheaf works out the rest paragraph by paragraph.
language.documentLanguageHint: Set this when a document is in a different language from the rest of the project.
language.checkingHint: English is checked on this device, offline. Chinese is never checked: no engine is worth the false positives, so Sheaf says nothing instead of guessing.
language.languageToolHint: Optional, and empty by default. Fill this in only if you run a LanguageTool server yourself; Sheaf will then send paragraphs in languages it cannot check offline to that address. Plain http:// only, so it can only be your own machine or network.
language.languageToolActive: Paragraphs Sheaf cannot check offline are sent to {{endpoint}}.
language.endpointMustBeHttp: The address must start with http:// — Sheaf only talks to a server you run.
language.dictionaryEmpty: Nothing yet. “Add” on a suggestion puts a word here, and it travels with the project.

principles: No ads. No tracking. Your words stay on this device.
